verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents the trigger-and-data half of this workflow. Registrable webhooks fire when meetings are processed, including a team-wide Super Admin webhook, and the GraphQL transcript query plus the MCP server let an agent pull meeting details. The product also generates action items after every meeting, so an agent could fetch them and file them into a tracker. No evidence shows a native Linear, Jira or Asana automation, and the API docs do not explicitly show action items as a returned field, so the filing step depends on the agent or Zapier. Missing for 10: native project-tracker integrations (Linear/Jira/Asana), an explicitly documented action-items field in the API/webhook payload, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end action-item filing flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows, integrate with other tools
Connect Fireflies webhooks to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.
The transcript query is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript ID.
Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
The Fireflies MCP Server enables AI tools to connect directly to your meeting data without switching platforms or copying transcript excerpts.
